notes.m6graded-then-shapes: Shapes invented by m6-graded for Then over two Checked simulations (beyond release only, ours, not in the specification): Value (ComposedArrow (Source A) (Target C) (Kind Simulation) (Grade 0)); Evidence (Composition (Rule RelationalComposition) (First S1 H1) (Second S2 H2)) followed by (Certificate (Kind Simulation) (Relation H1_then_H2) ..) of the composite relation, replayed under M5-NondeterministicReplay. The release Then shape has no Grade field and no Composition form. Grade 0: both premises are exact simulations and directed grades add (spec Table 4 l.893-909). See arrow_kinds.Simulation.
notes.m6graded-shapes: Shapes invented by m6-graded (beyond release only). Graded kernel hives: CrossKernel entries may be rationals in [0, 1] (spec Def 10.1 l.2821); a degree outside [0, 1] is InvalidInput. CheckKernelCoherence Refuted evidence (Witness (Triple a b c) (Degrees c_ab c_bc c_ac)) with Lukasiewicz transitivity c_ac >= c_ab (x) c_bc; Holonomy Value is a Kernel with (Rat) entries (max-(x) composition); ConsensusCost evidence (Closure (Classes n) (Raised (Raise ..)..)); LeastCoherentRefinement uses the same LP certificate with Edge rows x_ab <= c_ab (dual value sum c_ab y_ab) and EdgeMass = sum w_a w_b c_ab; CompleteHive certificate (Method LukasiewiczPathClosure) with (Fill a b (Degree F) (Path ..)) rows, Unsupported when a measured entry is below its closure; HiveAssociator Entries carry (Rat) direct / composite / difference values. Crisp hives keep their M6 / M6-rest shapes byte for byte.
